subject.title: refactor(config): retire legacy flat streaming keys to doctor-owned migration [HOLD: compat decision]

question: After preserving the public plugin SDK resolver contract, should bundled nested-channel flat-key runtime support be removed before the recorded July 26, 2026 removal date?
rationale: The patch author intentionally placed this operator-visible compatibility break on hold, and repository evidence cannot determine whether maintainers want to shorten the shipped upgrade window.

options.title: Honor the removal window
options.body: Keep bundled runtime alias reads through July 26, 2026 while retaining the completed doctor migrations and warnings, then remove them with upgrade proof.

options.title: Approve the early break
options.body: Remove bundled aliases now and explicitly accept that affected existing gateways require a manual doctor repair before startup.

options.title: Split migration fixes first
options.body: Land the doctor correctness and coverage fixes separately while postponing all runtime fallback removal.

recommendation.title: Honor the removal window
recommendation.body: Keep bundled runtime alias reads through July 26, 2026 while retaining the completed doctor migrations and warnings, then remove them with upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked umbrella program and prior channel-runtime history make steipete the strongest available owner for the sequencing decision, although ownership is shared with SDK and compatibility-area contributors.
